content:
maria-gonzalez: hey @people-ops - i’m hoping to request an accommodation. i've been having chronic migraines that make commuting unpredictable. my doc recommended alternating remote work (3 days in office / 2 remote) for a few months. what's the process? :wave:

ash-manager: thanks for flagging, Maria. happy to support. can you DM me the high-level so i can plan coverage? we can also apply short-term adjustments immediately (flexible start, quieter seating).

people-ops-bot: @maria-gonzalez People Ops here — we can help. high-level steps: 1) submit an accommodation request form (https://intranet.redwood/hr/accom-form) 2) medical note from your provider 3) review with manager + HR. typical turnaround ~5 business days; DM us to start. :lock:

hr-jordan: Maria — we’ll keep this confidential. you can request interim adjustments (noise-cancelling headphones, flexible hours, low-traffic desk) while your formal request is processed. i’ll DM the provider note template and the consent language.

maria-gonzalez: thanks! can the accommodation include occasional in-office exceptions for specific dates (all-hands, product demos)? also worried about details being shared with the broader team.

people-ops-bot: yes — the accommodation plan can include scheduled exceptions (documented). information is shared on a need-to-know basis only; manager receives only what's necessary to implement the plan. sample all-hands language we use: 'will attend in-person for pre-scheduled critical meetings as agreed with manager.'

ash-manager: i can handle coverage planning and will keep the team-level notes minimal. also, if helpful, facilities can move Maria to a corner/low-traffic desk and provide an adjustable lamp on her in-office days — @facilities?

facilities: we can swap desks to a corner/low-traffic spot and provide an adjustable lamp + sound-dampening headphones if needed. ETA 3 business days once we get the ticket.

maria-gonzalez: appreciate it. timeline question: i can DM the note today, but i have a likely migraine spike next week — is 5 business days typical? would need faster approval for initial remote days.

hr-jordan: we can expedite to ~2 business days for requests marked urgent with a provider note indicating need. please DM the note and cc me and ash so we can triage.

people-ops-bot: summary / next steps: 1) Maria DM People Ops + attach provider note and mark if urgent; 2) manager + HR review (expedite if indicated); 3) facilities ticket to move desk and provide interim gear; 4) accommodation plan documented and shared on need-to-know basis. ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
